questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe encryption and key management in Azure
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Encryption at rest: encryption capabilities for Azure virtual-machine disks.
Encryption at rest: protecting stored data by encoding it while it resides on disks or other storage media.
Encryption in transit: protecting data while it moves across networks, commonly with protocols such as TLS.
Azure Storage Service Encryption: verifying the identity of a person, service, or device before granting access.
Encryption in transit: an encryption key whose lifecycle is managed by Microsoft for the service.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Encryption at rest — protecting stored data by encoding it while it resides on disks or other storage media; and Encryption in transit — protecting data while it moves across networks, commonly with protocols such as TLS.
